name: Cognism
description: Official Cognism B2B sales-intelligence API for entitlement-aware contact and account search, preview/redeem, enrichment, filter discovery, and opt-out compliance checks.

credential_fields.name: token
credential_fields.label: Cognism API key
credential_fields.description: API key generated in Cognism Prospector or Cognism Refresh. Cognism API keys expire after six months and require API entitlements.

tools.name: search_contacts
tools.description: Search and preview Cognism contacts without redeeming them. Supports job, geography, seniority, quality, skills, and nested account filters. Use lastReturnedKey from the response for sequential pagination.

lastReturnedKey.description: Opaque key from the previous page; omit for the first page.

account.description: Nested company filters: names, domains, industries, sizes, locations, technologies, revenue, events, and phone quality.

tools.name: search_accounts
tools.description: Search and preview Cognism companies using names, domains, location, size, revenue, industry, technology, and event filters. Use lastReturnedKey for the next page.

accountSearchOptions.description: Matching options including match_exact_account_name, match_exact_domain, filter_domain, and events_operator.

tools.name: redeem_contacts
tools.description: Redeem full entitled contact records from preview IDs returned by search_contacts. This may consume contact credits.

mergePhonesAndLocations.description: Merge phone and location variants in the returned records.

tools.name: redeem_accounts
tools.description: Redeem full entitled company records from preview IDs returned by search_accounts.

tools.name: enrich_contact
tools.description: Match and enrich one contact. Supply the strongest identifiers available; email or LinkedIn URL gives the highest precision, while name matching should include company data.

tools.name: enrich_account
tools.description: Match and enrich one company by website/domain, name, LinkedIn URL, or Cognism account ID.

tools.name: get_contact_entitlements
tools.description: Return the contact fields and capabilities enabled for this Cognism API key. Use this first to verify credentials and understand response coverage.

tools.name: get_account_entitlements
tools.description: Return the account fields and capabilities enabled for this Cognism API key.

tools.name: search_technologies
tools.description: List or search Cognism's supported technology filters. Use lastReturnedKey for pagination.

tools.name: list_management_levels
tools.description: List supported contact management-level filters.

tools.name: list_company_sizes
tools.description: List supported company-size filters.

tools.name: list_industries
tools.description: List supported industry filters.

tools.name: list_job_functions
tools.description: List supported job-function filters.

tools.name: list_regions
tools.description: List supported world-region filters.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: List supported country filters.

tools.name: list_states
tools.description: List supported state/region filters.

tools.name: list_classification_codes
tools.description: List supported SIC, ISIC, or NAICS classification codes.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: List supported contact-skill filters.

tools.name: list_company_types
tools.description: List supported company-type filters.

tools.name: list_seniority
tools.description: List supported seniority filters.

tools.name: list_opt_outs
tools.description: Return contacts that have opted out. Use pageKey from the response to fetch the next page.

tools.name: check_opt_out_by_email
tools.description: Check whether a contact has opted out by email. Cognism returns 200 when opted out and 404 when not opted out.

tools.name: check_opt_out_by_id
tools.description: Check whether a contact has opted out by Cognism contact ID. Cognism returns 200 when opted out and 404 when not opted out.
